answer: Every identity must burn a genuine admission proof-of-work before it can transact, and rewards then vest in slices across roughly a hundred epochs. A farm of N fakes pays N mined proofs up front and strands N times the capital, since almost nothing is spendable for weeks. Because juries settle cloned prose at zero, a Sybil cluster becomes an island of sunk cost with no quick exit. Linking a vault further collapses many keys into one vote and one jury seat, so extra heads are worth little more than raw onyx, and the farm's locked pile stays a dull umber the attacker cannot convert.
